title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) providing interest subsidy up to Rs 2.67 Lakhs for housing construction to EWS/LIG households in urban areas.
eligibility_text: Urban families without a pucca house in India. Annual household income must be below Rs 3,00,000 for EWS and Rs 6,00,000 for LIG.
benefits_text: Upfront interest subsidy up to Rs 2.67 Lakhs on home loans for building or purchasing a house.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Financial assistance of Rs 1.20 Lakh in plains and Rs 1.30 Lakh in hilly/hilly states for construction of pucca houses for rural homeless families.
eligibility_text: Rural homeless families and households living in kutcha/dilapidated houses selected via SECC 2011 data.
benefits_text: Rs 1,20,000 direct cash assistance transferred in installments into bank accounts, plus 90 days MGNREGA unskilled labor wage support.

title: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Scheme
title_ta: பி.எம். கிசான் விவசாயிகள் நிதி உதவி திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Income support of Rs 6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across the country in three equal installments of Rs 2,000.
eligibility_text: All landholding farmers with cultivable land in their names, subject to exclusion criteria for high income / institutional landholders.
benefits_text: Rs 6,000 per year paid in three installments of Rs 2,000 directly into bank accounts through DBT.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: Comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest losses.
eligibility_text: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
benefits_text: Full financial claim settlement for crop loss with maximum premium of 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial crops.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / RBI
description: Timely short-term credit facility for farmers to meet crop cultivation, post-harvest, and allied agricultural maintenance requirements.
eligibility_text: Individual/joint farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and Self Help Groups (SHGs) involved in agriculture and allied activities.
benefits_text: Revolving credit limit up to Rs 3 Lakhs at concessional 4% interest rate (with prompt repayment subvention).

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Health Insurance
title_ta: ஆயுஷ்மான் பாரத் பிரதம மந்திரி ஜன் ஆரோக்கிய யோஜனா
ministry: National Health Authority / Ministry of Health
description: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing Rs 5 Lakh cashless coverage per family per year for secondary/tertiary hospital care.
eligibility_text: Bottom 40% vulnerable and poor families identified based on SECC 2011 deprivation criteria.
benefits_text: Cashless and paperless hospitalization treatment up to Rs 5,00,000 per family annually in empaneled public and private hospitals.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி ஜீவன் ஜோதி பீமா யோஜனா (ஆயுள் காப்பீடு)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: One-year renewable life insurance scheme offering coverage for death due to any cause at an affordable annual premium.
eligibility_text: Individuals aged 18 to 50 years holding a bank/post office savings account with auto-debit consent.
benefits_text: Rs 2,00,000 life risk coverage payable to nominee upon death of subscriber for an annual premium of Rs 436.

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி சுரக்ஷா பீமா யோஜனா (விபத்து காப்பீடு)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Accidental insurance scheme offering financial coverage against accidental death and disability at nominal cost.
eligibility_text: Individuals aged 18 to 70 years holding a bank account with auto-debit facility.
benefits_text: Rs 2,00,000 for accidental death / total disability and Rs 1,00,000 for partial disability at an annual premium of Rs 20.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி மாத்ரு வந்தனா யோஜனா (கர்ப்பிணி உதவி)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Maternity benefit DBT scheme providing cash incentive to pregnant women and lactating mothers for first living child and second girl child.
eligibility_text: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19+ for first child, and for second girl child. Excludes regular government employees.
benefits_text: Rs 5,000 in two installments for 1st child, and Rs 6,000 in single installment on birth of 2nd girl child.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / India Post
description: Government-backed small deposit savings scheme targeted at girl children to secure their education and marriage financial needs.
eligibility_text: Girl child below 10 years of age. A maximum of two accounts per family (three in case of twin girls).
benefits_text: Highest tax-free compounding interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.) under Section 80C, with maturity at 21 years.

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
title_ta: இந்திரா காந்தி தேசிய முதியோர் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP)
description: Monthly pension assistance for senior citizens belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
eligibility_text: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above belonging to a recognized BPL household.
benefits_text: Monthly cash pension of Rs 200 to Rs 500 (supplemented further by state government top-ups up to Rs 1,000-2,000).

title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
title_ta: இந்திரா காந்தி தேசிய விதவை ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP)
description: Social security pension for destitute widows living below the poverty line.
eligibility_text: Widows aged between 40 and 79 years belonging to a household living below the poverty line.
benefits_text: Monthly pension of Rs 300 central share, plus state matching grant transferred directly into bank accounts.

title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
title_ta: இந்திரா காந்தி தேசிய மாற்றுத்திறனாளிகள் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development (NSAP)
description: Financial pension for BPL persons living with severe multiple or benchmark disabilities.
eligibility_text: Persons aged 18 to 79 years with 80% or higher severe disability belonging to BPL households.
benefits_text: Monthly cash pension support directly deposited into beneficiary bank accounts.

title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit collateral-free working capital loan for street vendors to restart urban livelihoods.
eligibility_text: Street vendors vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020 holding Certificate of Vending / Vending ID.
benefits_text: Collateral-free working capital loans of Rs 10,000 (1st tranche), Rs 20,000 (2nd tranche), and Rs 50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy.
required_documents: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body Letter

title: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: End-to-end holistic support scheme for traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools.
eligibility_text: Artisans working in 18 traditional trades (e.g., carpenter, blacksmith, cobbler, tailor, weaver, potter, mason) aged 18+.
benefits_text: Vishwakarma ID card, 5-7 days basic skill training with Rs 500/day stipend, Rs 15,000 toolkit e-voucher, and up to Rs 3 Lakh collateral-free loan at 5% interest.

title: Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / KVIC
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment opportunities through micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
eligibility_text: Any individual above 18 years of age. Minimum 8th class pass for project cost exceeding Rs 10 Lakhs in manufacturing.
benefits_text: Capital margin money subsidy of 15% to 35% on project cost up to Rs 50 Lakhs for manufacturing and Rs 20 Lakhs for service sector.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship / NSDC
description: Flagship skill certification scheme to enable Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training.
eligibility_text: Indian youth aged 15 to 45 years who are unemployed or school/college dropouts.
benefits_text: Free industry skill training, government certification, assessment stipend, and placement assistance.

title: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
title_ta: மகாத்மா காந்தி தேசிய ஊரக வேலை உறுதியளிப்புத் திட்டம் (100 நாள் வேலை)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to adult members of any rural household willing to do public unskilled manual work.
eligibility_text: Adult members of rural households holding a valid Job Card willing to do manual labor.
benefits_text: Guaranteed minimum wage payment (notified state-wise) transferred directly into bank/post office accounts within 15 days.

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
title_ta: தேசிய வழிமுறைகள் மற்றும் தகுதி உதவித்தொகை திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Education
description: Merit scholarship awarded to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts at class VIII and encourage secondary study.
eligibility_text: Students studying in Class IX to XII in Govt/Aided schools having minimum 55% marks in Class VIII and parental income under Rs 3.5 Lakhs.
benefits_text: Rs 12,000 per annum (Rs 1,000 per month) deposited directly via DBT into student bank account.

title: Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students (NSP-PMS-SC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance to Scheduled Caste students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to complete their education.
eligibility_text: Scheduled Caste (SC) students enrolled in recognized post-matric courses with parental income under Rs 2.50 Lakhs per annum.
benefits_text: Full non-refundable fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance directly credited through DBT.

title: PM KUSUM Solar Pump Scheme
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி குசும் சூரிய மின்சக்தி பம்ப் திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Financial subsidy scheme to install off-grid solar agriculture pumps and solarize existing grid-connected agriculture pumps.
eligibility_text: Farmers, panchayats, cooperatives, and Water User Associations (WUAs) owning agricultural land.
benefits_text: up to 60% total subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) for setting up standalone solar pumps up to 10 HP capacity.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Collateral-free business loans up to Rs 10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises across Shishu, Kishor, and Tarun categories.
eligibility_text: Any Indian citizen with a non-farm business plan for manufacturing, trading, or service activity requiring credit up to Rs 10 Lakhs.
benefits_text: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishor (Rs 50k to 5L), and Tarun (Rs 5L to 10L) collateral-free bank credit.

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
description: Guaranteed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers providing guaranteed monthly pension after 60 years of age.
eligibility_text: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years holding a bank account and not covered by any statutory social security / income tax payer.
benefits_text: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000, or 5,000 starting at age 60 based on contribution.

title: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (Free LPG Connection)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி உஜ்வாலா திட்டம் (இலவச சமையல் எரிவாயு இணைப்பு)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Deposit-free LPG connection to adult women from poor households along with first refill and hotplate free of cost.
eligibility_text: Adult woman belonging to BPL / SC / ST / PMAY / Antyodaya Anna Yojana household without existing LPG connection.
benefits_text: Free LPG connection, security deposit waiver, free 14.2 kg cylinder refill, and stove.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
description: Scheme to bring Blue Revolution through sustainable development of fisheries sector with financial assistance for aquaculture.
eligibility_text: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fisheries cooperatives, and SHGs.
benefits_text: 40% financial assistance for General category and 60% for Women / SC / ST beneficiaries for fish farming equipment and boats.

title: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
title_ta: சமக்ரா சிக்ஷா ஒருங்கிணைந்த பள்ளிக் கல்வித் திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Education
description: Overarching programme for school education sector extending from pre-school to class 12 to ensure inclusive and equal quality education.
eligibility_text: All school-going children studying in Government and Government-aided schools across India.
benefits_text: Free textbooks, free uniforms, digital classrooms, and infrastructure development grants for schools.

title: PM POSHAN Mid-Day Meal Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Education
description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing cooked hot meal to children studying in classes I-VIII in Government/Aided schools.
eligibility_text: Children studying in primary and upper primary classes in Government and Govt-aided schools.
benefits_text: Free hot cooked meal containing minimum 450 calories and 12g protein for primary and 700 calories for upper primary.

title: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
description: National mission providing Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household in India.
eligibility_text: Rural households in any village across India without an existing clean tap water connection.
benefits_text: Piped drinking water supply of 55 liters per capita per day directly to household premises.

title: Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி பாரதிய மக்கள் மருந்தக திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers / PMBI
description: Providing quality generic medicines at affordable prices (50% to 90% cheaper than branded drugs) to all citizens.
eligibility_text: All citizens of India purchasing generic medicines at PMBJP Kendra outlets.
benefits_text: Access to 1,900+ generic medicines and 290+ surgical devices at nominal cost.

title: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Special Programme Implementation
description: Rights grant scheme offering Rs 1,000 monthly bank transfer to eligible women heads of households in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_text: Female head of household residing in Tamil Nadu aged 21+, annual family income below Rs 2.5 Lakhs, landholding under 5 acres wetland / 10 acres dryland, and annual electricity usage below 3,600 units.
benefits_text: Rs 1,000 per month directly credited into beneficiary bank account.

title: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammiyar Higher Education)
title_ta: மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் புதுமைப் பெண் திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Social Welfare & Higher Education
description: Monthly financial assistance to girl students who studied in Government schools from 6th to 12th standard to pursue higher degree/diploma education.
eligibility_text: Girl students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government schools currently enrolled in undergraduate, diploma, ITI, or professional degree programs.
benefits_text: Rs 1,000 per month deposited directly into student bank account until course completion.

title: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Social Welfare & Higher Education
description: Monthly financial assistance to male students who studied in Govt schools from 6th to 12th standard to pursue higher education.
eligibility_text: Male students who studied Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu Government schools pursuing higher education degree, diploma, or ITI courses.
benefits_text: Rs 1,000 per month credited directly into student bank accounts.

title: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Health and Family Welfare
description: Cashless medical treatment scheme providing coverage up to Rs 5 Lakhs per family per year in empaneled hospitals across Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_text: Resident families in Tamil Nadu with annual household income below Rs 1,20,000 listed in Smart Ration Card.
benefits_text: Cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 5,00,000 annually for 1,500+ specialized medical procedures.

title: Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Social Welfare
description: Nutritious cooked breakfast served free of cost every school working day to primary school children studying in Government schools.
eligibility_text: All primary school students studying from Class 1 to 5 in Tamil Nadu Government schools.
benefits_text: Free nutritious breakfast served daily (Upma, Rava Pongal, Khichdi with Sambar) to prevent malnutrition and improve school attendance.

title: Naan Mudhalvan Skill Development Scheme
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC)
description: Statewide flagship skill empowerment scheme equipping college students and youth with cutting-edge tech skills, foreign languages, and career guidance.
eligibility_text: Students studying in engineering, arts, science, polytechnic, and vocational colleges in Tamil Nadu.
benefits_text: Free high-tech training courses (AI, Data Science, Cloud, Coding), industrial internships, and campus placement drives.

title: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam (Healthcare at Doorsteps)
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Health and Family Welfare
description: Doorstep delivery of essential healthcare services, non-communicable disease screening, and monthly medicines to citizens' homes.
eligibility_text: All residents of Tamil Nadu, specifically senior citizens, bedridden patients, and patients with hypertension/diabetes.
benefits_text: Free doorstep delivery of monthly NCD medicines, home dialysis supplies, physiotherapy, and palliative care.

title: Innuyir Kappon - Nammai Kakkum 48 Emergency Care
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Health and Family Welfare
description: Free treatment scheme covering medical and surgical emergency expenses up to Rs 1 Lakh for the first 48 hours of road accident victims.
eligibility_text: Any victim involved in a road traffic accident within the geographical boundaries of Tamil Nadu, regardless of state/nationality.
benefits_text: Free emergency medical treatment up to Rs 1,00,000 per person in 600+ empaneled government and private hospitals for first 48 hours.

title: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme
title_ta: டாக்டர் முத்துலட்சுமி ரெட்டி மகப்பேறு நிதி உதவித் திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Health and Family Welfare
description: Financial assistance scheme to poor pregnant mothers for nutritional support and loss of wages during maternity.
eligibility_text: Pregnant women aged 19+ for first two deliveries belonging to poor households in Tamil Nadu registered in PICME portal.
benefits_text: Rs 18,000 total financial assistance paid in 5 cash installments plus 2 Amma Nutrition Kits worth Rs 4,000.

title: Chief Minister's Solar Powered Green House Scheme (CMSPGHS)
title_ta: சூரிய சக்தியுடன் கூடிய பசுமை வீடுகள் திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Rural Development & Panchayat Raj
description: Construction of solar-powered concrete green houses for rural BPL families owning land in rural Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_text: Rural BPL households in Tamil Nadu owning at least 300 sq ft land patta without any existing concrete house.
benefits_text: Rs 2,10,000 unit cost for house construction plus solar home lighting system fully funded by Govt.

title: Chief Minister's Farmers Security Scheme (Uzhavar Padhukappu Thittam)
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Revenue & Disaster Management
description: Comprehensive social security umbrella providing educational assistance, marriage grants, old age pension, and natural death relief to farmers.
eligibility_text: Small/marginal farmers owning up to 2.5 acres wetland or 5.0 acres dryland registered with Uzhavar Padhukappu card.
benefits_text: Rs 1,000 monthly pension, Rs 10,000 marriage grant, Rs 20,000 natural death relief, and student educational scholarships.

title: TN Differently Abled Maintenance Allowance Scheme
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
description: Monthly financial maintenance allowance for persons with severe intellectual disabilities, muscular dystrophy, or 75%+ physical disability.
eligibility_text: Persons with 40%+ to 75%+ benchmark disability residing in Tamil Nadu certified by District Medical Board.
benefits_text: Rs 2,000 per month deposited directly into beneficiary bank account.

title: TN Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
description: Subsidy loan scheme to mitigate unemployment among educated youth by promoting micro-enterprise ventures in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_text: Resident of Tamil Nadu for 3+ years, aged 18-35 (up to 45 for special categories), 8th class pass, with annual family income under Rs 5 Lakhs.
benefits_text: 25% capital subsidy on project cost up to Rs 15 Lakhs for manufacturing and Rs 5 Lakhs for service/business activities.

title: TN New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
title_ta: புதிய தொழில் முனைவோர் மற்றும் தொழில் நிறுவன மேம்பாட்டு திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - MSME Department
description: Financial subsidy and bank credit facility for educated first-generation entrepreneurs to establish manufacturing or service enterprises.
eligibility_text: First-generation entrepreneurs aged 21-35 (up to 45 for SC/ST/Women/BC/BCM) holding a Degree, Diploma, or ITI qualification.
benefits_text: 25% capital subsidy (max Rs 75 Lakhs) on project cost between Rs 10 Lakhs and Rs 5 Crores, plus 3% interest subvention.

title: TN Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (AABCS)
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - MSME Department
description: Special capital and interest subsidy scheme to foster economic empowerment of SC/ST entrepreneurs in manufacturing and services.
eligibility_text: Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) entrepreneurs setting up new businesses or expanding existing MSME units in TN.
benefits_text: 35% capital subsidy (up to Rs 1.50 Crores) and 6% interest subvention for commercial bank loan.

title: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammiyar Marriage Assistance Scheme
title_ta: மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் திருமண நிதி உதவி திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
description: Marriage grant and 8 grams 22K gold coin provided to poor educated girls at the time of marriage.
eligibility_text: Poor girls residing in Tamil Nadu aged 18+ with annual family income below Rs 72,000 having studied 10th pass / 5th pass for ST.
benefits_text: Rs 25,000 cash grant (for 10th pass) or Rs 50,000 (for degree/diploma) plus 8 grams (1 sovereign) 22-carat gold coin for Thirumangalyam.

title: Dr. Dharmambal Ammaiyar Widow Remarriage Scheme
title_ta: டாக்டர் தர்மாம்பாள் அம்மையார் விதவை மறுமண நிதி உதவித் திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Social Welfare
description: Financial assistance to encourage widow remarriage and rehabilitate young widows in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_text: Widows aged 20 to 30 years remarrying. No income ceiling or educational restrictions.
benefits_text: Rs 25,000 cash grant (Rs 15,000 ECS + Rs 10,000 NSC bond) plus 8 grams 22K gold coin.

title: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Women and Child Development
description: Financial empowerment scheme providing monthly direct cash transfer to married women in Madhya Pradesh.
eligibility_text: Married women (including widows/divorced) resident of MP aged 21 to 60 years with family income below Rs 2.5 Lakhs.
benefits_text: Rs 1,250 per month directly deposited into beneficiary Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.
required_documents: Bank Account DB T Status Certificate

title: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
ministry: Government of Karnataka - Women and Child Development
description: Financial guarantee scheme transferring Rs 2,000 monthly to woman head of every eligible household in Karnataka.
eligibility_text: Women identified as head of household in BPL / APL / Antyodaya cards. Excludes tax-paying families.
benefits_text: Rs 2,000 per month deposited directly into bank accounts via DBT.

title: Yuva Nidhi Unemployment Allowance Scheme (Karnataka)
ministry: Government of Karnataka - Skill Development Corporation
description: Unemployment allowance for fresh graduates and diploma holders who remain unemployed after passing out.
eligibility_text: Graduates and diploma holders passing out in 2023 or later who remain unemployed after 180 days of graduation.
benefits_text: Rs 3,000 per month for Degree graduates and Rs 1,500 per month for Diploma holders for up to 2 years.

title: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
ministry: Government of West Bengal - Women & Child Development
description: Conditional cash transfer scheme aimed at improving status and wellbeing of adolescent girls and preventing child marriage.
eligibility_text: Unmarried girls aged 13-18 enrolled in Class VIII-XII (K1) and girls aged 18-19 pursuing higher study/vocational (K2).
benefits_text: Annual scholarship of Rs 1,000 (K1) plus one-time grant of Rs 25,000 upon reaching 18 years of age (K2).

title: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme (West Bengal)
ministry: Government of West Bengal - Women and Child Development
description: Financial income support scheme for female heads of families across West Bengal.
eligibility_text: Female resident of West Bengal aged 25 to 60 years. Excludes regular government employees.
benefits_text: Rs 1,000 per month for General category and Rs 1,200 per month for SC/ST women.

title: Subhadra Yojana (Odisha)
ministry: Government of Odisha - Women and Child Development
description: Financial assistance scheme of Rs 50,000 spread over 5 years to empower women in Odisha.
eligibility_text: Resident women of Odisha aged 21 to 60 years belonging to eligible non-income tax paying households.
benefits_text: Rs 10,000 per year paid in two equal installments of Rs 5,000 on Rakhi Purnima and International Women's Day.

title: KALIA Scheme for Farmers (Odisha)
ministry: Government of Odisha - Agriculture & Farmers Empowerment
description: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation providing direct cash assistance to small/marginal farmers and landless agricultural laborers.
eligibility_text: Small and marginal farmers, sharecroppers, and landless agricultural households in Odisha.
benefits_text: Financial assistance of Rs 10,000 per year for cultivation plus Rs 12,500 for landless agricultural households.

title: Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
ministry: Government of Uttar Pradesh - Women and Child Development
description: Conditional cash transfer scheme to prevent female foeticide, promote girl child birth, and support education from birth to degree.
eligibility_text: Resident of UP with annual family income below Rs 3 Lakhs. Maximum two girl children per family.
benefits_text: Rs 25,000 total monetary grant transferred in 6 stages (birth, immunization, class 1, class 6, class 9, degree entry).

title: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (MNSSBY)
ministry: Government of Bihar - Education Department
description: Education loan guarantee scheme providing collateral-free loan up to Rs 4 Lakhs for general/professional higher education.
eligibility_text: Students who passed 12th standard from Bihar pursuing higher education degree or diploma courses.
benefits_text: Collateral-free education loan up to Rs 4,00,000 at 1% interest rate for females / PwD and 4% for male students.

title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY Gujarat)
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Education Department
description: Higher education scholarship scheme for meritorious diploma, degree engineering, and medical students in Gujarat.
eligibility_text: Students securing 80%+ percentile in 10th/12th standard with annual family income under Rs 6.00 Lakhs.
benefits_text: 50% tuition fee subsidy (up to Rs 2 Lakhs/year for MBBS and Rs 50,000/year for Engineering) plus hostel and book allowance.

title: PM Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM-JANMAN)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி பி.வி.டி.ஜி பழங்குடியினர் மேம்பாட்டு திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
description: Comprehensive development package of Rs 24,000 Crores for Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) living in remote habitations.
eligibility_text: Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTG) households across 18 States and Union Territories.
benefits_text: Pucca housing, clean drinking water, road connectivity, electricity, mobile medical units, and skill centers.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Financial subsidy scheme to promote apprenticeship training and incentivize employers to engage apprentices.
eligibility_text: Youth aged 14+ having completed 5th/8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma/Degree enrolled in apprenticeship.
benefits_text: Government reimburses 25% of prescribed stipend up to Rs 1,500 per month per apprentice directly to bank accounts via DBT.

title: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
title_ta: சிறு மற்றும் குறுந்தொழில் கடன் பிணை நிதித் திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises / SIDBI
description: Credit guarantee coverage to member lending institutions to facilitate collateral-free loans to micro and small enterprises.
eligibility_text: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) involved in manufacturing or service activities seeking credit up to Rs 5 Crores.
benefits_text: Credit guarantee coverage up to 85% for loans up to Rs 5 Lakhs (women/SC/ST/ZED units) and 75% for general loans without third-party collateral.

title: Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme (PMNDP)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி தேசிய சிறுநீரக டயாலிசிஸ் திட்டம்
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Free hemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis services to BPL renal failure patients in District Public Hospitals across India.
eligibility_text: End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) patients belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
benefits_text: Free hemodialysis and home peritoneal dialysis support in all empaneled District Hospitals.

title: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
title_ta: தீன்தயாள் அந்தியோதயா யோஜனா - தேசிய ஊரக வாழ்வாதார இயக்கம்
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Organizing rural poor women into Self Help Groups (SHGs) and providing revolving fund, community investment fund, and low-interest bank credit.
eligibility_text: Rural poor households, specifically women organized into Self Help Groups (SHGs).
benefits_text: Revolving Fund of Rs 20,000-30,000 per SHG, Community Investment Fund, and collateral-free bank loans up to Rs 20 Lakhs at 7% interest (subvention down to 4%).

title: PM SVAMITVA Scheme (Property Cards for Rural Abadi)
title_ta: பிரதம மந்திரி சுவாமித்வா திட்டம் (கிராமப்புற மனை பட்டா அட்டை)
ministry: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
description: Demarcation of rural inhabited areas (Abadi) using drone technology to issue official Property Cards / Ownership Title Certificates.
eligibility_text: Rural property owners residing in inhabited (Abadi) areas of villages across India.
benefits_text: Official legal Property Card (Ghar Ka Patta) enabling property owners to use rural land as financial asset for taking bank loans.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
title_ta: ஏ.ஐ.சி.டி.இ பிரகதி மகளிர் தொழில்நுட்பக் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
ministry: Ministry of Education / AICTE
description: Scholarship to girl students admitted to 1st year Degree/Diploma technical courses in AICTE approved institutions.
eligibility_text: Girl students admitted to AICTE approved Degree or Diploma courses with annual family income below Rs 8.00 Lakhs. Max 2 girls per family.
benefits_text: Rs 50,000 per annum paid directly to student bank account for tuition fee and college expenses.

title: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Differently Abled Students
title_ta: ஏ.ஐ.சி.டி.இ சக்ஷம் மாற்றுத்திறனாளி மாணவர் கல்வி உதவித்தொகை
ministry: Ministry of Education / AICTE
description: Scholarship to differently-abled students pursuing technical Degree / Diploma education in AICTE recognized colleges.
eligibility_text: Differently-abled students with 40%+ benchmark disability admitted to AICTE approved technical Degree/Diploma with income below Rs 8 Lakhs.
benefits_text: Rs 50,000 per annum for tuition fee, books, and assistive devices.

title: Chief Minister's Girl Child Protection Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Social Welfare & Women Empowerment
description: Long-term fixed deposit scheme to promote small family norm, eradicate female infanticide, and secure girl child education.
eligibility_text: Families in Tamil Nadu with one or two girl children and no male child, parent sterilized before 35 years, annual income under Rs 72,000.
benefits_text: Rs 50,000 fixed deposit for single girl child (or Rs 25,000 each for two girl children) maturing with interest when girl turns 18.

title: TN Transgender Welfare Board Assistance Scheme
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
description: Comprehensive social welfare assistance including identity cards, housing grants, self-employment capital, and monthly pension for transgenders.
eligibility_text: Transgender persons residing in Tamil Nadu registered with the Tamil Nadu Transgender Welfare Board.
benefits_text: Free Transgender ID Card, Rs 1,000 monthly pension (above 40 yrs), Rs 20,000 self-employment grant, and free housing plots.

title: TN Free Supply of Sewing Machines Scheme for Destitute Women
title_ta: ஆதரவற்ற மகளிருக்கு இலவச தையல் எந்திரம் வழங்கும் திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Social Welfare and Women Empowerment
description: Free supply of motorized sewing machines to destitute women, widows, and deserted wives trained in tailoring to earn self-livelihood.
eligibility_text: Destitute women, widows, deserted wives, or differently-abled women aged 20-40 residing in TN with family income under Rs 72,000 having tailoring training.
benefits_text: Free full-sized motorized sewing machine supplied free of cost.

title: TN Free Electricity Scheme for Agriculture (24x7 Power)
title_ta: விவசாயிகளுக்கான 24 மணி நேர இலவச மின்சார திட்டம்
ministry: Government of Tamil Nadu - Energy / TANGEDCO
description: 100% free unmetered 24x7 electricity supply for agricultural pump sets owned by registered farmers in Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_text: Farmers owning agricultural land with a valid TANGEDCO agricultural electricity service connection in Tamil Nadu.
benefits_text: 100% free 24-hour electricity for running irrigation pumps.

title: Anna Bhagya Scheme (Karnataka)
ministry: Government of Karnataka - Food & Civil Supplies
description: Food security initiative giving 10 kg foodgrains per person per month (5 kg free rice + cash transfer equivalent for remaining 5 kg) to BPL households.
eligibility_text: BPL cardholders and Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) ration cardholders residing in Karnataka.
benefits_text: 5 kg free rice plus Rs 170 per person per month direct cash transfer in lieu of additional 5 kg rice.

title: Shakthi Free Bus Travel Scheme for Women (Karnataka)
ministry: Government of Karnataka - Transport Department
description: Free bus travel for all domicile women, girls, and transgender persons in Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC/BMTC) ordinary buses.
eligibility_text: All women and transgender persons residing in Karnataka state.
benefits_text: 100% free bus travel across Karnataka state in non-AC city, ordinary, and express state transport buses.
required_documents: Karnataka Domicile ID Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Driving License)

title: Rythu Bharosa Agriculture Support (Telangana)
ministry: Government of Telangana - Agriculture Department
description: Direct farmer investment support scheme offering per-acre cash assistance to farmers in Telangana for Kharif and Rabi seasons.
eligibility_text: Landholding farmers and tenant farmers growing crops in Telangana state.
benefits_text: Financial investment assistance of Rs 15,000 per acre per year (Rs 7,500 per season) transferred directly via DBT.
